notes: WhaleChat 3.73.0 — chat now follows the offline-first architecture: the bubble appears and is saved to IndexedDB on the phone before any network call, the Outbox syncs in the background every 2 s (retry 5/10/30 s, instantly on reconnect), messages are received through ONE Appwrite Realtime subscription instead of polling, history opens from cache first, and delivery ticks show clock / single / double / blue double. The existing lane stays only as a fallback while Realtime reconnects.
